# Neelachandra Construction and Interiors

> Neelachandra Construction and Interiors is a full-spectrum construction company founded in 2018 by Chandrashekar T, headquartered in Nelamangala, Bengaluru. It delivers residential, commercial, and industrial construction plus interior design and fit-out services across Bengaluru and Karnataka, backed by a 10-year structural warranty and BIS-certified materials.

Trusted by developers and manufacturers including Godrej Properties, Salarpuria Sattva, Honda Cars India, and Mandot Steel, with 30+ projects delivered and a 4.8★ client rating since 2018.

## Home
- [Home](https://neelachandra.com): Company overview, key stats, service categories, four-step process (Consult & Plan, Design & Approve, Build & Update, Handover & Move In), team summary, and homepage FAQ covering costs, warranty, materials, NRI/industrial suitability, and contact info.

## Projects / Portfolio
- [Projects](https://neelachandra.com/projects): Portfolio stats (30+ projects, 60+ acres, 8+ years) and featured industrial projects for Excellence Technologies, Recipharma, Honda Cars India, VRL Automation, and Mandot Steel.
- **Portfolio Breakdown**: Residential villas, commercial complexes, interior fit-outs, and infrastructure project counts.
- **Developer & Client Partners**: Godrej Properties, Salarpuria Sattva, Casagrand, Honda, VRL Automation, and others.
- **Projects FAQ**: Coverage areas, site visits, industrial capability, residential villas, and quote process.

## Packages (Pricing)
- [Packages](https://neelachandra.com/packages): Four residential construction tiers — Silver (₹2,299/sqft), Platinum (₹2,699/sqft), Gold (₹3,099/sqft, most popular), Diamond (₹3,499/sqft).
- **Why Choose Neelachandra Packages**: Fixed pricing with no escalation, branded/documented materials, 10-year warranty, single project coordinator.
- **Packages FAQ**: Cost breakdowns by plot size, inclusions/exclusions, payment schedules, material brands, quality testing, warranty terms, and timelines.

## Services
- **Architecture & Structural Civil Engineering**: Floor plans, elevations, structural drawings, approvals, soil testing.
- **Landscape Construction and Garden Design**: Garden planning, compound walls, driveways, irrigation, outdoor lighting.
- **Structural Waterproofing and Sealing**: Terrace, basement, and wet-area waterproofing using Fosroc and Dr. Fixit systems.
- **Renovation and Remodeling**: Structural strengthening, space reconfiguration, kitchen/bathroom remodeling, facade upgrades.
- **Construction Equipment and Machinery Rental**: Excavators, cranes, scaffolding, generators, and site logistics support.
- **Construction Consultation and Specialist Assistance**: Structural assessments, stalled project rescue, remote project management for NRI clients.
- **Services FAQ**: Standalone architecture hires, renovation costs, waterproofing warranties, equipment rental terms, and mobilization times.
